remarks:
Welcome to 515 N Forest, a spacious 4-bedroom, 2-bath home set back on a large, nearly ¾-acre corner lot in the Williamsville School District. Offering privacy, flexible living spaces and extensive recent updates, this home delivers space and versatility that are hard to find.
The living room features a wood-burning fireplace and included wall-mounted big screen TV that flows into the formal dining room and chef inspired kitchen. The kitchen offers abundant cabinetry, stainless steel appliances and a premium Viking range with double ovens, six burners and built-in griddle. The first floor includes a spacious primary bedroom, full bath and additional bedroom with built-in bookshelves and sliding glass doors to the patio and expansive backyard. Hardwood floors are underneath the first-floor bedroom carpeting.
Upstairs are two generously sized bedrooms and a full bath with updated shower. 
A versatile BONUS room off the mudroom and attached garage has its own heat source and rear door access, making it ideal for a private home office, studio, guest space or hobby room.
The basement adds even more usable space with a built-in bar, second kitchen and gas fireplace—ideal for entertaining, movie nights, game days or extended living.
The attached two-car garage features a new 100A breaker box and mounted heater with remote, creating a comfortable year round workshop. Plenty of parking on the extra wide driveway. 
Major updates provide peace of mind, including a 200A electrical service upgrade, recessed lighting and new outlets/switches with dimmers (2023). The second floor bedrooms were rebuilt to the studs with new electrical, insulation and drywall. Two furnaces with A/C, many updated windows, new hot water tank (2024), new sump pump with backup (2024) and main sewer line replacement (2025).
Conveniently located near shopping, dining, parks and everyday amenities, 515 N Forest offers generous living space, privacy and flexibility in a desirable Williamsville location.
